dose-response-curve-two-pesticides.alt: Two curves of percent of test fish killed against dose in mg per kg (invented data). Pesticide Y (circles) kills 0% at 0 and 10, 8% at 20, 25% at 30, 50% at 40, 72% at 50, 88% at 60, 97% at 80 and nearly all fish above that. Pesticide X (squares) kills 0% up to 20, 2% at 30, 6% at 40, 12% at 50, 22% at 60, 50% at 80, 76% at 100, 90% at 120 and 98% at 160. Dashed lines read the LD50s: 40 mg/kg for Y and 80 mg/kg for X, so Y is more toxic. Y's curve first rises above zero between 10 and 20 mg/kg, X's between 20 and 30 mg/kg.
